idea-plugin.name: Lean 4
idea-plugin.description:
Write Lean 4 proofs and programs in your JetBrains IDE.

  • Interactive InfoView: see proof goals, local hypotheses, and expected types as you move the cursor. Pin proof states, inspect messages and traces, and use project widgets.
  • Semantic highlighting: distinguish types, typeclasses, constructors, functions, fields, local variables, and proof hypotheses with customizable colors.
  • Editing and navigation: code completion, diagnostics, quick documentation, code actions, inlay hints, rename, find usages, go to definition, call hierarchy, and proof folding.
  • Unicode input: type Lean abbreviations such as \alpha for α, search the symbol picker, and define your own translations.
  • Project tools: manage elan toolchains, create Lake projects, build, run, and test code, update dependencies, and download Mathlib caches. Remote development is supported.
  • Library discovery: browse dependency sources and module imports, and search for definitions and theorems with Loogle.

To get started, install elan and a Lean 4 toolchain, open your Lake project folder, and open a .lean file. Toolchain settings are under Settings → Languages & Frameworks → Lean.

Additional semantic highlighting, proof folding, and module hierarchy depend on your Lean version.
